fields.title: Detik article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields scraped from news.detik.com. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, from the Google News sitemap) carry title/link-style fields. Upstream JSON-LD and sitemap XML are passed through close to verbatim, so field presence and shape can vary per record.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value that produced this record: the article URL in article mode, or 'latest' in latest mode.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html for articles, S2-sitemap for latest headlines, or 'none' on error records).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle.headline).

description.title: Description
description.description: Article summary/description (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle.description).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text (article mode), assembled from the

tags in div.detail__body-text, with ad-slot placeholder paragraphs (class para_caption) and empty paragraphs excluded. Paragraphs are joined with double newlines.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Article publish date (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle.datePublished).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Article last-modified date (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle.dateModified).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article author name (article mode; extracted from JSON-LD NewsArticle.author.name, may be null if author is not a structured object).

image.title: Image URL
image.description: Article lead image URL (article mode; extracted from JSON-LD NewsArticle.image.url, may be null if image is not a structured object).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline of a latest/sitemap item (latest mode; from the sitemap's news:title element).

link.title: Link
link.description: URL of a latest/sitemap item (latest mode; from the sitemap's loc element).

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publish date of a latest/sitemap item (latest mode; from the sitemap's news:publication_date element).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords/tags of a latest/sitemap item (latest mode; a list split from the sitemap's news:keywords element, empty list if absent).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
